newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.798 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.798 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended June 21 was 4,798,750 gallons compared with 4,145,695 gallons last week.
Imports were 417,576 gallons compared with 127,711 gallons the previous week. There were 139,468 domestic receipts for this week compared with 53,470 the previous week.
Retail movement was 986,727 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,348,577 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 241,148,498 gallons.
The final total pack for the week was 1,689,502 gallons.
